data.description:
The data to render. To work well, this should be a collection of Obj instances. Special handling exists for
{@link FetchResult} and {@link EvaluateResult} since they are so commonly used, but any collection should be
displayable to some extent.

maxRows.description: If specified, no more than the given number of rows will be displayed.

title:
The console tabular data visualization. This instantiates the console tab labeled "Grid" (with the table icon).
It also creates the global function `c3Grid` that can be invoked with a collection of objects in JavaScript.
name: ConsoleGrid
